dedupe_keys.name: luxembourg 3d bridge models lod1 deck surfaces from 2019 lidar and lod3 hand modelled bridges from the administration du cadastre et de la topographie

description: The Luxembourg land registry and topography administration publishes a national dataset of 3D bridge models on the open data portal. Contents: for most bridges, simplified 3D polygons at level of detail 1 representing the drivable deck surface, extracted automatically from the 2019 national LiDAR point cloud; for a small selection, detailed level of detail 3 models built by hand; a 2D layer on the geoportal gives bridge identifiers. Producer: the Administration du cadastre et de la topographie. Coverage: bridges across the whole of Luxembourg. Format and access: CityGML archives for LOD1 (about 2.5 MB) and LOD3 (about 29 MB), plus DXF and Esri multipatch for the LOD3 bridges, in the LUREF coordinate system (EPSG:2169); the 3D viewer of geoportail.lu displays them. Licence: Creative Commons CC0. Caveats: LOD1 models give deck geometry only, with no structure type, material, span or condition, so they need linking to road authority inventories for assessment work; the snapshot reflects the 2019 flight. Simulation uses: clearance and deck elevation for flood exposure of bridges, 3D city and digital twin models, and locating bridges on the national road network. Related records: the ACT national 3D buildings 2023 (data-luxembourg-act-national-3d-buildings-2023) come from the same producer, and the digital national road network (data-luxembourg-pch-digital-national-road-network-geopackage) gives the roads they carry.
